description: We are an enthusiastic team passionate about space history. We plan to create engaging stories about NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars to inspire young learners about science.
summary: My project explores space history by telling engaging stories about discarded NASA equipment on the Moon and Mars to inspire young learners about science.
details: "Lunar Legacies" is an interactive educational platform designed to make NASA’s off-world exploration data accessible and exciting for young learners. Using authentic registries and imagery from NASA’s Moon and Mars Trek portals, the platform transforms discarded spacecraft hardware into engaging, first-person stories. Students explore interactive maps, inspect engineering specs, and complete short STEM quizzes to earn Explorer Badges, bridging the gap between raw technical data and classroom curiosity.
